scope: Current handwritten scientific CUDA under src/scf/cuda/direct_*; this overlay does not replace or reclassify the semantic CUDA ownership ledger.

families.capability: Generic bounded Direct-HF Fock/force contraction for shell classes whose exact consumer is not selected by the active generated/native registry.
families.current_selector: Default tuned bounded production must not enter this fallback for canonical s/p/d classes. It remains reachable for unpromoted higher-l classes, portable/unmeasured profiles, and explicit AOT class-filter diagnostics.
families.generated_alternative: IntegralIR value/derivative programs plus the production shell-class registry cover the tuned canonical s/p/d domain; additional higher-l classes require numerical/resource/endpoint qualification before their generic fallback can retire.
families.schedule_requirements: Preserve bounded topology traversal, symmetry, screening admission and output scatter without introducing a whole-quartet tensor. Production-qualified classes must fail closed rather than silently falling back to duplicate handwritten equations.
families.resource_profile: The fallback remains O(N_shell^2) in stored topology and bounded in task state. Retirement requires generated classes to preserve those memory bounds as well as endpoint performance.
families.retirement_condition: Delete the generic scientific fallback only after every supported production angular domain has a generated/class-specific qualified consumer or a compiler-owned generic lowering; until then, keep it quarantined from already-qualified tuned s/p/d production.

families.capability: Exact bounded native schedules retained for the dddd production exception and low-order ssss/psss force execution.
families.current_selector: The bounded runtime uses class-specific exact execution where the native schedule remains selected or where generated mathematics deliberately reuses the qualified native page scheduler. These paths are not the generic uncovered-class fallback.
families.generated_alternative: Generated shell-class consumers and weighted-ERI derivative callables already overlap these classes; retirement depends on matching the exact page/stream schedule and complete endpoint behavior, not on source emission alone.
families.schedule_requirements: Preserve direct pair-class enumeration, page-local screening, shared primitive work, bounded state, and single-counted force/Fock scatter while replacing only duplicate scientific algebra.
families.resource_profile: Retained routes exist because queue materialization or generated class schedules can regress endpoint/resource behavior; promotion requires register/stack/shared-memory and complete-endpoint evidence.
families.retirement_condition: Retire each class-specific native scientific body when its generated consumer preserves the qualified streaming/page schedule and passes RHF/UHF numerical, resource and endpoint gates; scheduler-only runtime may remain native.

families.capability: Native Direct J/K and Fock contraction families, including the retained psss Fock fast path and higher-angular ERI helpers used by Fock consumers.
families.current_selector: Generated shell classes are used where promoted; retained native Fock families remain selected for unpromoted or measured faster domains. psss force is already generated, but psss Fock is a separate retained target.
families.generated_alternative: The existing IntegralIR/AOT class registry already represents the underlying ERI mathematics; psss Fock still needs generated shared-work execution that matches the historical fused primitive/Boys traversal.
families.schedule_requirements: Share primitive/Boys work across Fock outputs, preserve symmetry/scatter semantics, and choose materialization/rematerialization from measured register and occupancy evidence rather than Direct-only shape tests.
families.resource_profile: Register/shared-memory pressure and repeated primitive work are the primary retirement constraints; endpoint selection must consume generic target/resource evidence.
families.retirement_condition: For each retained Fock family, demonstrate generated mathematical parity plus matched complete-endpoint non-regression; then delete the duplicate native scientific body unless an independently measured exception remains.

families.capability: Order-0/1, generic order-two, and total-order-three Direct force mathematics consume compiler-owned Weighted IntegralIR; retained low-order files own runtime contraction and scheduling.
families.current_selector: Order-0/1 and total-order-three generated shell workers bypass the generic quartet path. Both exact order-two schedulers and the generic AO-quartet fallback call the same generated PSPS/PPSS/DSSS force roots.
families.generated_alternative: Weighted IntegralIR first derivatives and force-only roots provide the shared mathematical source through total order three; remaining optimization concerns schedule and consumer profitability, not duplicate native derivative formulas.
families.schedule_requirements: Preserve center recovery, arbitrary external weights, shared quartet work, and native fixed/resident/paged schedule semantics while moving optimization choices to generic compiler schedules.
families.resource_profile: Promotion must compare complete force endpoint time plus registers/stack/shared memory and actual primitive/derivative work; generated source existence alone is insufficient.
families.retirement_condition: Promote and delete each native low-order formula only after independent derivative checks and matched RHF/UHF fixed/resident/paged endpoint gates pass for the claimed domain.

families.capability: Order-4/5/6 Direct force canonicalization, primitive contraction, pair algebra, complete primitive ERI-gradient composition, and the bounded high-order Coulomb recurrence are compiler-generated.
families.current_selector: Production order-4/5/6 force directly includes the build-time generated consumer and its compiler-emitted high-order Coulomb recurrence while retaining the existing queue/runtime schedule and selector semantics.
families.generated_alternative: The compiler emits the complete order-4/5/6 force-side consumer together with its shared high-order Coulomb workspace and recurrence support; no native high-order Coulomb mathematical owner remains.
families.schedule_requirements: Use common multi-root sharing, live-range shortening, pressure-aware rematerialization/fission, and bounded pair-term storage; do not add an order-specific Direct optimizer.
families.resource_profile: High register/stack pressure and repeated combinatorial traversal are the critical measured risks; peak workspace and actual recurrence walks must be reported with endpoint timing.
families.retirement_condition: The order-4/5/6 consumer body and high-order Coulomb recurrence are retired from native scientific ownership. Remaining pair/source helpers stay tracked separately until their other production consumers have qualified generated replacements.

families.capability: Shared native Cartesian, shell-class, Hermite, pair and contraction helpers still needed by retained Direct scientific consumers.
families.current_selector: These helpers are reached through retained native Direct families; they are not independently selected as a second public method path.
families.generated_alternative: Common IntegralIR recurrence/spec ownership can replace these helpers only when every dependent production consumer has a generated lowering with equivalent sharing and resource behavior.
families.schedule_requirements: Keep recurrence mathematics separate from queue/runtime plumbing, preserve shell symmetry and pair reuse, and avoid deleting shared helpers while any qualified fallback still depends on them.
families.resource_profile: Compact pair geometry and bounded local intermediates are part of the existing performance envelope; a generated replacement must not multiply recurrence work or unbound local storage.
families.retirement_condition: Delete a shared native helper only after all production consumers that depend on its scientific mathematics have qualified generated replacements; runtime-only traversal may remain native.

families.capability: Density/Schwarz/page screening, exact bounded task admission, and bounds that define the admitted Direct-HF scientific work domain.
families.current_selector: Direct-HF applies these policies while forming bounded/generated pages and active quartet domains; page/task enumeration is runtime structure, while its physical density/Schwarz admission remains scientific/controller policy rather than duplicate ERI algebra.
families.generated_alternative: Generated consumers may consume the admitted domain, but retirement is not justified merely by moving the same policy into generated source.
families.schedule_requirements: Preserve physical screening/error semantics independently from generic queue compaction and scheduling; coordinate changes with the numerical error-policy owners.
families.resource_profile: Screening must remain work- and memory-bounded and expose active-domain/work counts; looser policy cannot be used to manufacture a performance win.
families.retirement_condition: Retain as explicit scientific policy unless a shared policy owner replaces it with identical validated admission semantics; do not count a policy relocation as formula retirement.

families.capability: Separately compiled native Direct force consumer used as a retained qualified execution candidate/control.
families.current_selector: Available through explicit Direct execution policy; its filename does not grant independent-oracle status and the semantic ownership ledger continues to classify it as scientific.
families.generated_alternative: Generated weighted-ERI derivative consumers are the retirement direction for overlapping mathematical capability.
families.schedule_requirements: Keep this route explicit and bounded; never treat agreement between this consumer and another lowering of the same mathematics as independent validation.
families.resource_profile: Retain only while its bounded execution/resource behavior provides a qualified control or measured production advantage.
families.retirement_condition: Remove when generated consumers cover the same production domain with independent numerical qualification and no measured complete-endpoint disadvantage.
